The younger mechanic, onscreen in the garage.

claims.text: Two mechanics argue over an engine in a cramped garage.
The garage is cluttered with paint cans, a coiled hose, cardboard parts boxes, a workbench, a stack of tires, and a high grimy window that lets in weak daylight.
The older mechanic has gray stubble and wears a faded navy work shirt; the younger mechanic has dark hair pushed back, rolled sleeves, and a small grease smear on one cheek.
The car is a dark blue sedan with its hood raised, and the idling engine shivers the hood prop and nearby tools.
The younger mechanic wipes his hands on a gray shop rag and tosses it onto the workbench before answering.

summary.text: In a cramped garage, two mechanics clash over a worn engine part as the older man points out the damage and the younger man pushes back.

description.text: A cramped repair garage, walls close on both sides, shelves crowded with paint cans, coiled hose, and cardboard parts boxes. A dark blue sedan sits with its hood raised, the open engine bay wedged between a workbench and a stack of tires. Weak daylight from a high, grimy window falls across the valve cover and catches the frayed ribs of a drive belt. The older mechanic, gray stubble and a faded navy work shirt, leans over the front fender. His shoulders fill the tight space; one forearm braces on the radiator support while a rag-wrapped finger presses toward the split belt. He does not look up, jaw set, breath visible in the cool air. The younger mechanic stands across the bay, partly behind the raised hood, one hand resting on a socket wrench. The older man’s finger taps the belt twice, then withdraws as he speaks his flat verdict. The younger man’s grip tightens on the wrench; the idling engine shivers the loose hood prop and sends a thin rattle through the shelves. Dust drifts in the window shaft.
Low room tone and the uneven tick of an idling engine fill the garage.
The older mechanic presses a rag-wrapped finger against the frayed drive belt.
He taps the belt twice and withdraws his hand.
The idling engine shivers the hood prop; dust drifts through the high window light.
Metal ticks softly as the engine idles.

The younger mechanic steps around the fender into the clearer space beside the workbench, wiping both palms down a gray shop rag. His dark hair is pushed back, sleeves rolled, a small grease smear along one cheek. He straightens to face the older man across the engine bay, chin lifted, shoulders squared, and tosses the rag onto the bench. The older mechanic remains bent over the engine, one hand flat on the valve cover, watching him from under his brow. Between them, the open hood frames a tangle of hoses and the worn belt. The idle drops to a rougher pulse; a wrench rocks against a tray, then settles. The younger man plants one boot on the lower front crossmember, leans in, and answers with his own four-word challenge, holding the older man’s stare. The overhead bulb flickers once, hardening the shadows in the creases of the garage.
The idle drops to a rougher pulse; a wrench rocks against a metal tray.
The younger mechanic wipes both palms on a gray shop rag and steps around the fender.
He tosses the rag onto the workbench and plants one boot on the lower front crossmember.
The overhead bulb flickers; shadows deepen across the open engine bay.
The wrench settles against the tray with a small clink.

soundscape: Low garage room tone, an uneven engine idle, small metallic ticks, and close corrugated-wall echoes.
